card.name: Scattered words in educational and tech text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on assorted small words (ampersand, 'approved', 'two', 'a', 'several', 'this', 'the') in instructional web text about math, teaching or programming.
card.plain: It fires on mixed small words in school and computing instructions, with no pattern a reader could use.
